title: Maurya Empire
summary: Chandragupta Maurya founded an empire based in Magadha, ruling from Pataliputra. At its height it held the main cities and routes of the subcontinent except the deep south.
why: A vast early Indian empire; Ashoka's edicts are a key source for it.

notes.problem: 'Ruled most of the Indian subcontinent' overstates; source: 'briefly controlled the major urban hubs and arteries of the subcontinent excepting the deep south'.
